verses.1: And for you, who are now dead, due to your sins and transgressions.
verses.2: In those times when you were governed by the laws of this world’s cycle, under the rule of the power of the air, the spirit that operates within all things.
verses.3: In those instances, we too are sometimes overwhelmed by the desires of our flesh. We act according to the desires of our flesh and our passions. And then, like everyone else, we become children of anger.
verses.4: But the rich God is also merciful. This is because of the great love He has for us.
verses.5: And by His actions, we who are dead were raised to life through Christ—so that we may be united with Him.
verses.6: And he also stood among the angels in Christ Jesus.
verses.7: So that the superabundant riches of His grace may be demonstrated in our lives, through Christ Jesus.
verses.8: For by grace you are united together through faith. And this gift does not come from you; it comes from God.
verses.9: Not from any work, so that no one can boast about it.
verses.10: For this is indeed a “poem” in which we are engaged; it was created by Christ Jesus, for good works that God has prepared, so that we may walk in them.
verses.11: Therefore, remember that sometimes you, as nations, are made of flesh. Those who are called “acrobastia” are subject to the so-called “peritonitis” within their own flesh.
verses.12: Because at that time, they lived there apart from Christ; they were abandoned by the government of Israel, and they were strangers to the laws of prophecy. They had no hope, and they were considered atheists in this world.
verses.13: But now, in Christ Jesus, you who have been far away from Him, you have become close to Him through the blood of Christ.
verses.14: For that is our peace—the one who has made both of us equal, and who has removed the barrier between us. He is the one who eliminates hatred within his flesh.
verses.15: He abolished the laws of commands in doctrine, so that both could create a new person within themselves, thereby bringing peace.
verses.16: And by the cross, you can also reconcile them in one body with God, thereby overcoming their hatred towards each other.
verses.17: And he came to bring you peace, both to those who are far away and to those who are close by.
verses.18: For through him we both receive the adoption into one spirit with the Father.
verses.19: So, they are no longer strangers and foreigners; instead, they are fellow citizens of the saints and children of God.
verses.20: Built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, who were disciples of Christ Jesus.
verses.21: In which all the buildings were assembled, so that they could be turned into a holy place in the city.
verses.22: In that place also, you shall build yourselves into a dwelling for God, in the spirit.
